title: 13 Best Herbal Tinctures For Headaches
description: Ginkgo biloba tinctures have been traditionally used to treat headaches, including migraines and tension headaches, due to their ability to improve blood flow to the brain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ginkgo biloba, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and bilobalide, have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate headache symptoms.
